title: Prometheus Dynamics Quantum Execution Portfolio - Authoritative Cross-Repository Accounting & Job-ID Deduplication Ledger
scope_note: Single authoritative accounting source across all 14 quantum repositories under PrometheusDynamicsCanada (excluding standalone Linux XDP security repository argus-server-protection, fusion repository Hyperion-fusion-telemetry, classical NVIDIA H100 GPU runs, simulations, unrecovered queue dispatches, and setup smoke tests). Every hardware Job ID / AWS Braket Task ARN is counted exactly once (867 unique records = 857 completed benchmark jobs/tasks + 10 auxiliary records).

matched_107_job_ibm_compiler_corpus_summ.scope_separation_note: Kept strictly separate from whole-portfolio job/shot totals because chemistry, scheduling, and spatial-multiplexing campaigns evaluate domain-specific acceptance criteria rather than all seven three-way compiler observables below. Each of the 107 completed three-way comparisons receives equal weight.
matched_107_job_ibm_compiler_corpus_summ.dilution_note: Unweighted corpus means weight each comparison by its baseline metric magnitude: 24 shallow or decoupled comparisons (13 sparse 3-Regular MaxCut QAOA at ~0.92 baseline F_B and 11 contiguous-chain Quantum Volume at ~0.66 baseline F_B with zero routing-SWAP delta) contribute 51.6% of SABRE's total F_B sum, diluting the +26.31% vs. SABRE (+50.00% median) and +100.45% [2.00x] vs. TKET (+350.08% median) distribution-overlap gains achieved on the 69 complex Dense All-to-All (K_N, 7Q-23Q) comparisons.
